title: VivoPower Confirms Strategic Update and Results Conference Call Moved to November 16, 2026
body_markdown:
VivoPower PLC (Nasdaq: VIVO) (“VivoPower” or the “Company”), a leading B Corp-certified global developer and owner of powered land and data center infrastructure for AI compute applications, today announced that its previously scheduled results conference call and webcast has been rescheduled from November 10, 2026, to **Monday, November 16, 2026, at 8:00 a.m. Eastern Time** .


The call, now titled “Strategic Update and Results Presentation,” will provide investors and analysts with a review of the Company’s financial results and strategic developments.


Webcast access and telephone dial-in details are available on VivoPower’s investor relations website at[https://www.vivopower.com/investors](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=RdTo6jJ4855lx8_h-lkY2F3GSkbws3h5YhT13XEVVu827St0b248qbFYiC0QJebJ5pnmyiipkwHCQ2u5FXaBsAoG89G8RHTF8EnsmFEvSbNADDmqrSCwRRxaahLzO52W-6WAU27X4_cC5A79KqnOcg==) .
